# Accord Advisors

> > Accord Advisors is a CPA firm serving Bloomington and Avon (Indianapolis area), Indiana, with clients nationwide. The firm acts as an outsourced accounting department for optometry practices, medical professionals, dental practices, service businesses, churches, and individuals — handling bookkeeping, payroll, tax preparation and planning, and business foundation services. Distinctives include fixed monthly fees instead of hourly billing, a secure online platform, nearly 40 years of industry-specific healthcare experience, and CFO-level insight delivered at a fraction of the cost of an in-house hire.
